---
title: "{{< fa calendar-check >}} Horario"
toc: false
execute:
  freeze: false
  always: true
---

> **Nota:** Este horario es **tentativo** y está sujeto a cambios.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false

library(googlesheets4)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
source("scripts/calendario/schedule-config.R")
gs4_deauth()

sheet <-
  read_sheet(
    schedule_config$workbook,
    sheet = schedule_config$target_tab,
    range = "A:I"
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: schedule
#| echo: false

sheet2 <- sheet %>%
  mutate(
    Objetivo = ifelse(is.na(Objetivo), "", Objetivo),
    Fase = ifelse(is.na(Fase), "", Fase),
    Día = ifelse(is.na(Día), "", Día),
    Fecha = as.Date(Fecha, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  )

sheet2 |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Fase") |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    Objetivo = "",
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    Objetivo ~ pct(4),
    Capítulo ~ pct(15),
    Día ~ pct(3),
    Fecha ~ pct(9),
    Enfoque ~ pct(35),
    Plan ~ pct(6),
    Diapositiva ~ pct(6),
  ) |>
  # Alignment for better readability
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(Capítulo, Enfoque)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(Día, Fecha)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(Plan, Diapositiva, Objetivo)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  text_transform(cells_body(columns = c(Objetivo)), fn = function(x) {
    case_when(
      x == "interpretive" ~ as.character(fontawesome::fa("video")),
      x == "interpersonal" ~ as.character(fontawesome::fa("comments")),
      x == "presentational" ~ as.character(fontawesome::fa("share-nodes")),
      x == "assessment" ~ as.character(fontawesome::fa("file-pen")),
      x %in% c("info", "administración") ~ as.character(fontawesome::fa("info-circle")),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  }) |>
  text_transform(cells_body(columns = c(Plan)), fn = function(x) {
    ifelse(
      is.na(x),
      fontawesome::fa("list-check", fill_opacity = 0.1),
      glue::glue(
        "<a href='{x}' target='_blank'>{fontawesome::fa('list-check')}</a>"
      )
    )
  }) |>
  text_transform(cells_body(columns = c(Diapositiva)), fn = function(x) {
    ifelse(
      is.na(x),
      fontawesome::fa("person-chalkboard", fill_opacity = 0.1),
      glue::glue(
        "<a href='{x}' target='_blank'>{fontawesome::fa('person-chalkboard')}</a>"
      )
    )
  }) |>
  fmt_date(Fecha, date_style = "day_m", locale = "es") |>
  sub_missing(columns = Fecha, missing_text = "") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = "14px")
```

### Leyenda

{{< fa info-circle >}} = Información \
{{< fa video >}} = Interpretativo \
{{< fa comments >}} = Interpersonal \
{{< fa share-nodes >}} = Presentacional \
{{< fa file-pen >}} = Evaluación
